name: squat-to-stand
instructions:
1. In an upright position, reach down and grab your toes.
2. Pull up on your toes to drop your hips into a deep squat.
3. Exhale while dropping your hips and pull your chest tall in the bottom.
4. Stand back up while still holding onto your toes and straighten the legs while looking at your shoelaces.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
starting_position: 1. In an upright position, reach down and grab your toes. 2. Pull up on your toes to drop your hips into a deep squat.
